notes.title: Free Update Delayed by COVID-19
notes.content:
The bad news is our main dev has been out for over three weeks with COVID-19. The good news is he's doing much better, and we have a free update for Conqueror 940 AD coming in October. Originally, the update was planned for August. We are continuing to support Conqueror 940 AD, but the health of our team is our number one priority.

The plans for our upcoming update include new questlines involving the princesses, some significant audiovisual enhancements, and bug fixes. Stay tuned for more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38518297/74ab8374fcf7970c56da296a2178282ca674c8f1.png[/img]

notes.title: v1.0.8 Research Patch - July 30, 2021
notes.content:
[list][*]Overhaul: We changed the formula for Food, Wood, Stone, and Iron income to be more accurate and make more sense in the resource increases.
[*]Fixed: Dialogue where 300 stone was taken from a player without that much stone.
[*]Fixed: Making a kingdom a vassal while they are sending troops to attack you no longer locks up the game.
[*]Fixed: Club bottom price having an extra 0.
[*]Changed: The Sign Post originally reported population incorrectly. Also, buffed research results from 10% to 25%.
[*]Fixed: Building the wood house no longer breaks end-turn button.
[*]Fixed: The Charm skill affects the speed of courting a lady just like kingdom relations now.
[*]Changed: Altered BTR Text for tournaments to be clearer.[/list]
Note!: The update is currently PC only. Mac build is coming soon.

notes.title: v1.0.7 Kingdom Patch - July 23, 2021
notes.content:
[list][*]Fixed: Player will no longer get repeatedly attacked by the same kingdom every turn.
[*]Fixed: Player getting attacked inconsistently.
[*]Fixed: Player getting blindsided by kingdom attacks.
[*]Updated: Updated dialogue to better reflect what is happening.
[*]Updated: If player has no troops, kingdoms will now raid rather than pillage, making the player lose 25% of their resources rather than 100%.
[*]Updated: Player no longer gets attacked by kingdoms that are a little unhappy. Now they are more likely to attack if they truly do not like you. More than 5 skulls.
[*]Updated: Cleaned up grammar/spelling/inaccuracies issues with researches and building text.[/list]

Note!: The update is currently PC only. Mac build is coming soon.

notes.title: Open Season on Bugs! The Bug Bounty Hunt Continues
notes.content:
Hello, Wombat Army! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1358260/view/3026951354697876323]Our first Bug Bounty Hunt[/url] was a success! We squished so many bugs we had to get an exterminator license. (Extra special thanks to SirCrown and Crosszeallot!) However, we’re not done.

Just because things are running much more smoothly doesn’t mean it’s time to stop. It’s open season on bugs. No more time limits. The Bug Bounty Hunt is open until further notice. You can still find out how it works below...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38518297/b3449a2f420a454865e2dd5a08bc2099d4949f48.png[/img]

Conqueror 940 AD is still in Early Access, which means we are expanding, polishing, tweaking, and perfecting.

How to join the Bug Bounty Hunt:[olist][*] Join our Discord with this handy dandy link right here: [url=https://discord.gg/V53yC7pATY]https://discord.gg/V53yC7pATY[/url]
[*] Find the #🐜-bug-reporting channel (or use this link: [url=https://discord.gg/bc6g3wQeBt]https://discord.gg/bc6g3wQeBt[/url]) and submit your bug! Alternatively, you can email us your report to social@combatwombats.net. Make sure you include...[olist][*] Your Windows/Mac version (and monitor resolution for graphic issues)
[*] Steps on how to make the wild bug appear (screenshots or video are best)[/olist][*] When you successfully submit a bug that we are able to reproduce, you get a point!
[*] Points can be redeemed for rewards at any time! (See below.)
[/olist]Rules:
[olist]
[*] Make sure your graphics drivers and DirectX are up-to-date before hunting those bugs.
[*] Bugs submitted must be unique/new. If it’s already been reported on Discord or in one of our various communities, it won’t count toward your rewards.
[*] We must be able to reproduce the bug on our end.
[*] If we suspect any deception on the part of a hunter, we will take away their points and ban them.
[*] Unspent points from the previous Bug Bounty Hunt still remain.
[/olist]Rewards:
[list]
[*] 0 points: You get sadness, try harder.
[*] 1 point: An exclusive wallpaper, featuring the lovely Amabel
[*] 5 points: A Steam key of the game’s soundtrack
[*] 10 points: Your name in the credits
[*] 15 points: Season pass for all future C940AD exclusive wallpapers
[*] 20 points: Combat Wombat Studios stickers
[*] 25 points: A Steam key of the game for a friend
[*] 35 points: A Combat Wombat Studios t-shirt
[*] 50 points: Be added to the game as a character/npc
[/list]
To redeem points just email social@combatwombats.net (or contact AdamMilecki on Discord) with your email address and what prize you would like. If it is a physical prize, Adam will ask for your address and real name for shipping purposes.

Good hunting, Wombat Army!

notes.title: 3/3/2021 Regular Update & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[h1]3/3/2021 Regular Update & Bug Fixes[/h1]

We wanted to help new players get acclimated so have added a tutorial. We also added the ability to use troops to defend against raids. Defensive buildings matter to prevent raids but if it happens, use your troops to hold them off. Finally, We did a full rebalance with all researches and building costs. This was to make things less tedious in late game, and a faster pace in the early game.

* You can now choose to defend against raids with your troops...or not.
* Added a Tutorial

notes.title: Minor Content Update 12/16/2020
notes.content:
Minor Content Update 12/16/2020

* Battle strategy hints, we tripled the number of strategy hints during battle to add more variety.

* The keeps have been cleaned up and made HD, also redesigned the top tier keeps completely.

* If you picked up the soundtrack you already have it but this update will add two new great tracks to the game.

* All dialogues now have an OK button to prevent dialogue from sticking if you click around too fast.

* Updated Manpower Gauge

* Minor fixes to Steam Achievements

* Taskbar Icon is no longer unity icon

* Added Next/Previous/Loop buttons for soundtrack within the game.

* Reorganization of Barracks UI, separated by troop type and can now click on troops and see each troop 
card with stats and more details.

* 100 new petitions added to the game.

notes.title: Hotfix 12/7/2020
notes.content:
Hotfix 12/7/2020

[b]Improvements:[/b]
* Custom Discord icon
* Added 22 achievements to Steam and in game
* Added in game encyclopedia / manual
* Released soundtrack onto Steam

[b]Game Balance:[/b]
* Cavalry now cost 3 food and 1 population

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
* Trade Values should now change daily. (existing games will need to confirm one trade for it to trigger correctly moving forward)
* Fixed missing audio track that would prevent people showing up in the throne room
* Fixed researches reducing build time making the time less than zero and blocking buildings from every getting built.
